notes.title: Free Update Chapter – Heart of Rot is now available
notes.content:
[h1]Howlo everyone 🐺[/h1]

We are back in 2025 with a big surprise for you: We have just released our new free update that contains[b] improvements and difficulty adjustments[/b] as well as a [b]completely free new chapter[/b] for you to play. It’s called Heart of Rot and lets you experience a new story with additional levels, new enemies and fresh ways to play. ✨

In Heart of Rot you embark on a side-story to the Capital, a city that has long stood as a bastion of hope in a world overrun by howling beasts. The Prophet has heard rumors that the alchemists there have found a cure for the Howl. When she arrives, she finds a city consumed by rot ...

This [b]update features[/b] its own chapter map, new enemies, a new boss level, innovative environment mechanics, the new Lightning Shot skill (which, once unlocked, can be used in the main game!), and an NPC who fights by your side in later levels. ⚡🏹

Access to this update is [b]FREE[/b] for anyone who has bought Howl. To play the new chapter, select it on the Chapter 3 map at [b]any point after having reached Chapter 3[/b] of the main story. Heart of Rot follows its own storyline and can be completed either before or after the main Howl story. 🐺

Also, please enjoy the new trailer we created for this update.

[previewyoutube=UVJQFvvOg7E;full][/previewyoutube]

Here is an [b]overview[/b] of all new things coming to Howl with the free new update. 👀

[b]One brand-new chapter including[/b]: 
[list]
[*] 16 new tactical puzzles that will keep new and experienced players on their toes. 
[*] 2 new enemy types and one new Boss that require you to think ahead. 
[*] New skill: Lightning Shot. Call upon the secret techniques of the royal guard. Take this new ability with you into the fights of the base game. 
[*] New environment: Rot has taken hold of the capital. Cleanse it with fire! 
[*] New story: The fall of the capital. The city had stood strong against the Howl. Now the walls crumble, the city rotting from within.  
[*] An NPC companion that helps you in your fights: Geli, head alchemist, helps you fight the plague spreading from within. 
[/list]
[b]The DLC also comes with improvements and difficulty adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fine-tuning of enemy action previews during move planning.
[*] Translation errors from the original release have been corrected.
[*] "Assist Mode" becomes the default difficulty setting (easier entry for newcomers).
[*] "Hard Mode" (disabled Assist Mode) for a tougher challenge
[*] Better balance between accessibility (newcomers) and challenging depth (veterans).
[/list]
Let us know what you think about Heart of Rot! 💭
[i]Your Howl Team [/i]🐺

notes.title: Steam Winter Sale: Save 33% on Howl
notes.content:
The Steam Winter Sale is here, and we’re excited to share the first sale for Howl! 

Save 33% on Howl and start planning your moves now – before the plague spreads further: 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/astragon/sale/wintersale2023]See all the astragon Winter Sale 2023 offers here[/url]

[h3]Not sure what Howl is all about? Let us walk you through it! [/h3]

In Howl, you plan your moves in advance, queueing your actions up to 6 turns ahead. 

[img]https://www.mipumi.com/_cjn63sho7wxdh/hwl_steam_plan.gif[/img]

With the Howl plague turning many people into wolves, they are always a threat to be dealt with. We've got only 2 health, but our crossbow makes short work of those beasts 🏹 

[img]https://www.mipumi.com/_cjn63sho7wxdh/hwl_steam_plan_execute.gif[/img]

Another option is to get dangerously close and shove those pesky beasts against obstacles... ...or themselves 🙌 

[img]https://www.mipumi.com/_cjn63sho7wxdh/hwl_steam_shove.gif[/img]

Line up your moves well, and you can use special powerful skills on certain slots. 💪 It pays off to plan well ahead! 

[img]https://www.mipumi.com/_cjn63sho7wxdh/hwl_steam_force.gif[/img]

...and that’s the basics! There’s much more to explore, and plenty of challenges with difficulty ramping up throughout 60 levels.  
With the Steam Winter Sale, now’s the best time to get Howl and enjoy this dark folktale. 🐺 

We wish you happy holidays and a good slide into 2024! 

The Howl team

notes.title: Changes are coming to Howl!
notes.content:
[h2]Howlo everyone! 🐺[/h2]

We loved reading and hearing everyone's feedback to the demo so far... so we're dedicating this month to changing a few things based on your comments!

You can expect improvements to audio elements, as well as gameplay balancing (those sneaky wolves were getting too sneaky!)
We also plan on expanding on the story, and getting even more creative with Living Ink.
There's more, but we will get to it when the time is right 👀

Until then, we hope you're as excited as we are!
Please make sure to wishlist Howl, it helps us a ton ✨

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2172180/Howl/

Cheers,
The Howl Team

notes.content:

[b]Howl[/b] producer Eline plays the first chapter of the game - and maybe even beyond 👀 - showing you what Howl has to offer. She'll walk you through the main gameplay elements, using skills and different strategies to defeat wolves and complete levels.

Watch David play to learn more about [b]Howl[/b] a turn-based tactical folktale set in a world of living ink, where the sound of a ‘howling plague’ is turning people into feral beasts.

Rid the lands of the plague using your crossbow, magic skills and your wits, planning every move up to six steps in advance.

Some think prophecy is carved in stone – [b]write your own in ink and blood.[/b]
